User Story: As a supervisor, I want to create a Pre-Task Plan documenting scope, hazards, and crew safety, so that all team members understand the plan before work begins.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety/ptp. Enter date, shift, project, location, scope of work, hazards (manual or Sage), PPE, muster point, hospital, first aid, weather/wind, heat illness controls, toolbox talk. Click 'Continue to crew sign-on' — validates scope/location/muster and advances to sign-on step.
Error Notes: 1) No double-submit guard on handleSubmit; 2) Invalid Date crash when date cleared (line 579 toISOString on bad date); 3) Missing res.ok checks on Sage fetch calls

User Story: As a supervisor on a multi-day project, I want to extend a PTP's validity beyond today, so that I don't re-enter identical information daily.
Expected Behavior: Set 'Valid through' date (up to 6 days out). Dashboard shows 'Day N of M' label and Active status for the duration. On expiry, dashboard shows Expired with 'Tap to renew'.
Error Notes: 1) Invalid Date crash if date cleared same as S01; 2) validUntil max calc crashes on empty dateOfPlan

User Story: As a supervisor, I want to carry forward hazards/PPE from yesterday's PTP, so that I pre-fill identical information.
Expected Behavior: On a new day without an active PTP, system detects previous PTP from past 7 days and shows 'Carry forward' banner. Clicking 'Apply' populates hazards, PPE, and site conditions. 'Skip' dismisses.

User Story: As a crew lead, I want crew members to digitally sign the PTP and designate a supervisor, so that we have acknowledgment records.
Expected Behavior: Click '+ Add signature'. Modal shows name field (autocomplete from roster), role dropdown, and signature pad. Draw signature → Save. Star button marks supervisor. Required: ≥1 signature + 1 supervisor.
Error Notes: 1) Supervisor star toggle <44px touch target; 2) Remove button no aria-label; 3) Name input autocomplete renders behind modal on mobile; 4) No keyboard nav for role/supervisor controls

User Story: As a safety planner, I want to list site hazards with risk ratings and controls, so that I document all identified risks.
Expected Behavior: Quick-add chips for common hazards. '+ Add hazard' for blank row. Each hazard: description, 4-level risk selector (Low/Medium/High/Critical), control measure field. X button removes row. Sage-suggested hazards show sparkle badge.
Error Notes: 1) CRITICAL: source field corruption — operator precedence bug (line 18) 'sage' || 'manual' always evaluates to 'sage'; 2) Delete button <44px touch target; 3) Risk selector buttons cramped on mobile

User Story: As a supervisor, I want Sage to suggest hazards based on scope and location, so that I don't miss critical risks.
Expected Behavior: Click 'Ask Sage to suggest hazards'. POSTs scope+location to /api/safety/suggest-hazards. Returns hazard array. Modal lists suggestions with toggle checkboxes. Select and click 'Add X hazards'. Added hazards tagged 'sage' source.
Error Notes: 1) Missing res.ok check before res.json(); 2) Toggle/Add/Cancel buttons <44px min-height; 3) 'Done with Sage' dismiss button tiny on mobile

User Story: As a crew leader, I want Sage to generate a toolbox talk topic, so that I facilitate a structured safety conversation.
Expected Behavior: Click 'Generate toolbox talk' (enabled when scope ≥3 words). POSTs scope/location/hazards/weather. Returns title and discussion question. Auto-fills topic field and discussion points.
Error Notes: 1) Missing res.ok check on fetch call (line 186)

User Story: As a supervisor, I want Sage to audit my PTP for completeness, so that I catch safety gaps before crew sign-on.
Expected Behavior: On sign-on step (after ≥1 signature), click 'Audit with Sage'. POSTs full PTP to /api/safety/audit-ptp. Returns pass/fail with findings (blocker/warning). Blockers prevent submission; warnings require acknowledgment.
Error Notes: 1) Missing res.ok check (line 255); 2) Stale audit result not invalidated when plan changes; 3) acknowledgedWarnings not cleared when returning to plan step

User Story: As a safety planner, I want to select required PPE items, so that everyone knows what protective equipment to wear.
Expected Behavior: Grid of PPE option chips. Each toggles on/off with visual feedback. Selected items stored as array. Sage can auto-suggest PPE based on hazards.

User Story: As an EHS coordinator, I want to create a JHA with sequential task steps, so that I systematically document hazards per work phase.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety/jha. Enter job title, date, validity window (optional), department, location, reference doc, PPE. Add numbered task steps with activity, hazards, controls, risk before/after, responsible person. '+ Add step' for more.
Error Notes: 1) No double-submit guard on handleSubmit; 2) resetNew() does not reset dateOfAnalysis or validUntil; 3) validUntil max date Invalid Date crash if dateOfAnalysis cleared; 4) 3-column grid cramped on mobile (320-375px)

User Story: As a safety planner, I want to upload a scope doc and have Sage extract steps, so that I don't manually type each task.
Expected Behavior: Click 'Upload a document'. File picker accepts .txt/.md/.csv/.pdf (≤3MB). POSTs to /api/safety/parse-document. Sage extracts title, location, department, PPE, and steps. Merges with existing steps.
Error Notes: 1) No file size check for non-PDF files (50MB text fully loaded into memory before slice); 2) Upload button brief race window for double-click

User Story: As a JHA preparer, I want Sage to analyze task steps and suggest hazards/controls, so that I have a data-driven starting point.
Expected Behavior: List ≥1 step, click 'Suggest hazards & controls'. POSTs title + step descriptions. Returns hazards, riskLevel, controls per step. Fills empty fields only, preserving user edits. Tagged '✨ via Sage'.
Error Notes: 1) Missing res.ok check (line 225); 2) CRITICAL: Sage overwrites user-set riskLevel values (lines 240-245 nullish coalescing inverted); 3) residualRiskLevel also overwritten

User Story: As a competent person, I want to issue a height permit documenting access, fall protection, and rescue, so that workers at height have authorization.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety/permits/height. Multi-step form: Details, Access method (chips), Fall protection (chips), Anchor points + Rescue plan, Pre-issue checklist, Validity window (from/until), Crew sign-on. Submit disabled until all required items complete.
Error Notes: 1) reset() doesn't clear projectName/location; 2) Submit button not disabled during submission; 3) projectName stepper/canSubmit inconsistency

User Story: As a fire safety officer, I want to issue a hot work permit with fire watch and atmosphere checks, so that hot work is controlled.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety/permits/hot-work. Multi-step: Details, Hot Work Type (chips), Fire Watch (checkbox + name), Post-monitoring duration (warns if <60 min), Extinguisher, Sprinkler status, Gas test (optional), Checklist, Validity, Crew sign-on.
Error Notes: 1) reset() doesn't clear projectName/location; 2) CRITICAL: postDuration <60 min not blocked for NFPA 51B compliance — only warns but allows submission

User Story: As an entry supervisor, I want to issue a confined space permit with atmospheric testing and rescue plan.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety/permits/confined-space. 7-step form: Details, Hazards (chips), Atmospheric test (O₂/LEL/CO/H₂S with real-time safe/warning/danger feedback), Rescue plan + Attendant, Pre-entry checklist, Validity, Entrant sign-on. Blocks submission if readings unsafe.
Error Notes: 1) reset() doesn't clear projectName/location; 2) CRITICAL: submit button disabled CSS is dead code — disabled: prefix never activates because disabled attr never set (line 578); 3) Missing validation errors for location and spaceDescription fields

User Story: As an entry supervisor, I want real-time feedback on gas readings to know immediately if space is safe.
Expected Behavior: As user enters readings, system checks: O₂ 19.5–23.5%, LEL <10%, CO <35 ppm, H₂S <10 ppm. Shows green/yellow/red indicators on input fields. Prevents permit issuance if ANY reading unsafe.
Error Notes: 1) CO threshold mismatch: form uses 35 ppm but atmo-check.ts warns at 25 ppm — ambiguous UX; 2) Cross-gas recommendations don't fire for unmeasured gases

User Story: As an entry supervisor with marginal readings, I want Sage expert guidance on entry feasibility.
Expected Behavior: Click 'Deep analysis with Sage'. POSTs readings + space description + hazards. Returns cross-gas interaction analysis, priority alerts, and recommendations. Displayed in collapsible panel. Falls back to offline analysis if no network.
Error Notes: 1) AI analysis only available when atmosphere already flagged unsafe — borderline-safe cases excluded from analysis

User Story: As a permit issuer, I want to set a specific time window for permit validity.
Expected Behavior: All permits show 'Valid from' and 'Valid until' datetime inputs. Default: 8h for Height/Hot Work, 4h for Confined Space. Prevents submission if 'until' ≤ 'from'. Shows red border + error if invalid.
Error Notes: 1) No max validity window cap; 2) No min validity window; 3) No past-date check; 4) Unclear error on empty datetime

User Story: As a competent person, I want to verify all safety checks before issuing a permit.
Expected Behavior: Collapsible checklist with permit-specific items. Critical items highlighted. Each item: checkbox, label, category tag, optional notes. Badge shows 'N required left'. Blocks submission until all critical items checked.
Error Notes: 1) Duplicate click targets for checkbox (accessibility); 2) Notes input missing aria-label

User Story: As a crew member, I want to report an incident with photos and analysis, so that we capture events for investigation.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety/incident. Enter project/location, type (injury/near-miss/property-damage/environmental), severity, date/time, description (≥20 chars), immediate actions, witnesses, injured person details, photos, root cause, corrective actions. Reporter signature required.
Error Notes: 1) reset() missing fields (type/severity/dateOfIncident/timeOfIncident not reset); 2) No double-submit guard; 3) immediateActions textarea missing from form despite being in record data

User Story: As a reporter, I want to take/upload photos of the incident scene.
Expected Behavior: Click camera icon. Photo picker opens. Selected file compressed (JPEG 80%, max 800px). Can add multiple. Each shown as thumbnail with remove option. Stored in IndexedDB linked to record.

User Story: As an investigator, I want Sage to suggest root causes and corrective actions.
Expected Behavior: Describe incident (≥20 chars), click 'Ask Sage to analyze'. Returns root causes (with category + why chain) and corrective actions (with control level + priority). Color-coded badges. User can adopt suggestions (marked '[AI-suggested]'). Offline fallback available.
Error Notes: 1) Missing res.ok check on fetch; 2) Sage categories/badges not validated before render — malformed API response could crash

User Story: As a user, I want form entries auto-saved so I can resume if interrupted.
Expected Behavior: Form state auto-saved to localStorage every 2s under key 'draft:${formType}'. On reload, restore banner appears with Restore/Dismiss. Restore populates all fields. Draft cleared on submit. Stale drafts (>7d) pruned on app start.
Error Notes: 1) dismissDraft doesn't clear localStorage (only sets dismissed flag in state — draft reappears on reload); 2) No error handling if localStorage is full

User Story: As a user, I want to see progress through multi-step permit forms.
Expected Behavior: Permit forms show horizontal scrolling stepper with step labels + completion badges (✓). Tracks scroll position, highlights current step. Click step pill to jump (scrolls into view).

User Story: As a repeat user, I want recently-used project/location auto-filled.
Expected Behavior: After form submit, project name and location saved to localStorage. On next form load, LastUsedChip appears below empty fields offering one-click apply.

User Story: As a manager, I want to view all records, filter by type, and search, so that I can review historical safety activity.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety/history. Full record list sorted newest first. Search box checks ID/location/project/creator/description. Type filter pills with counts. Pull-to-refresh on mobile.
Error Notes: 1) Search does not check record description field — only ID/location/project/creator

User Story: As a manager, I want to export filtered records to CSV.
Expected Behavior: Click 'Export CSV' button. Downloads CSV with columns: ID, Type, Project, Location, Created_By, Created_At, Status, Signatures, Sync_Status, Review_Status, Reviewed_By, Review_Decided_At.
Error Notes: 1) CSV export missing JHA-specific data (steps/hazards/controls); 2) Signature count shows '[object Object]' if signature data malformed

User Story: As a supervisor, I want to view a completed record with all data, signatures, and audit trail.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety/record/[id]. Shows: metadata, full form data, signature images with names/times/roles, photos, checklist states, sync status, review status, audit trail. Actions: Print, Share, Sync retry. Permit actions: Close, Revoke.
Error Notes: 1) closePermit/revokePermit called with undefined note if ConfirmDialog input is empty; 2) No loading indicator for sync retry or share; 3) Permit timer inverted status expression (line 215)

User Story: As an issuer, I want to close or revoke an active permit.
Expected Behavior: On open permit record view: 'Close Permit' and 'Revoke Permit' buttons. Confirmation dialog with optional notes. Updates status, appends audit event. Badge reflects new status.

User Story: As a supervisor, I want to print or share a safety record.
Expected Behavior: Print button opens browser print dialog (CSS hides no-print sections). Share button uses Web Share API or falls back to mailto. ?print=1 param auto-opens print.
Error Notes: 1) PWA standalone print via window.open fails silently with popup blocker; 2) Share mailto fallback uses window.location.href which navigates away from page

User Story: As an admin, I want safety records synced to Notion for centralized review.
Expected Behavior: After form submission, auto-sync attempted via POST /api/safety/sync. Batch sync on app load + reconnect. SyncQueuePanel shows pending records with retry buttons. Success: marked 'synced' with notionPageId. Failure: 'failed' status in queue.
Error Notes: 1) syncDisabled module-level flag never resets after 503 — stays disabled until page reload; 2) SyncQueuePanel retry gives no visual feedback distinguishing success vs re-failure

User Story: As a field worker without signal, I want to create records offline and auto-sync later.
Expected Behavior: All submissions saved to localStorage immediately (status 'offline'). Records displayed and searchable without sync. Background listener watches for 'online' event and retries pending/failed. Toast shows summary.

User Story: As a crew lead, I want to submit records for EHS review; as an EHS manager, I want to approve/reject with notes.
Expected Behavior: Submit button on record view → status 'submitted'. Poller checks /api/safety/review/status every 90s. Manager receives email link to /safety/review/action?token=... with Approve/Deny + notes. Decision syncs back to client. Recall button withdraws submission.
Error Notes: 1) Review action page confirm button missing type='button'; 2) Terminology mismatch: manager sees 'Denied' but employee sees 'Needs Revision'

User Story: As a permit issuer, I want to quickly reissue a closed/expired permit carrying over static config.
Expected Behavior: On closed/expired permit, click 'Reissue Permit'. Populates draft with project, location, work description, access/protection methods. NOT carried: crew, time-specific data, validity window. Issue as new record.

User Story: As a site safety officer, I want a dashboard showing PTP status, active permits, and recent incidents.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /safety. Shows: PTP stat card (Active/Expired/Not started), Active permits count, Incidents (last 7 days), Sync queue panel, EHS review banners, Quick action buttons, Active permit cards with timers, Recent activity list.
Error Notes: 1) PermitTimer receives inverted status — expired permits show active timer; 2) Active permits and Incidents stat cards not tappable (no href)

User Story: As a user, I want to sign in with Google, so that my identity is securely verified.
Expected Behavior: Click 'Continue with Google' → Google login → authenticated user sees dashboard with name and profile picture.

User Story: As an admin, I want email login with access code for environments without Google OAuth.
Expected Behavior: Fill name, email, access code (if production) → Sign in → validates domain and code → signs in or shows error.
Error Notes: 1) Error message says 'Invalid code' but doesn't indicate which field failed; 2) Access code input not type='password' — visible on screen

User Story: As a field worker, I want to work offline after signing in once.
Expected Behavior: First sign-in caches identity locally (72h TTL). If offline with valid cache, banner shows 'Offline — signed in as {name}'. Without cache, shows 'Sign in once to work offline'.
Error Notes: 1) isIdentityStale() with 72h TTL defined but never called — cached identities persist indefinitely; 2) clearAllLocalData removes wrong key 'sage-identity' instead of 'eqr-current-user'

User Story: As a user, I want to sign out securely.
Expected Behavior: Click avatar → menu → 'Sign out' → clears cached identity → redirects to sign-in screen.

User Story: As a user, I want to switch between dark, light, and system theme.
Expected Behavior: Click avatar → menu → 'Theme: {current}' → cycles Dark → Light → Auto. Persists in localStorage. Applies immediately.

User Story: As a user, I want to permanently delete all my data from this device.
Expected Behavior: Click avatar → menu → 'Delete my data' → confirm dialog → deletes all records, signatures, photos, drafts → signs out. Notion records unaffected.
Error Notes: 1) clearAllLocalData removes wrong identity key 'sage-identity' instead of 'eqr-current-user'; 2) IndexedDB deletion has no error handling — if it fails the promise resolves anyway

User Story: As a user, I want to navigate between major sections.
Expected Behavior: Desktop: sticky header with logo, nav links (Home, Pre-Trip, Assets, Orders, Safety), offline badge, help button, user menu. Mobile: simplified header; nav in bottom tab bar.

User Story: As a mobile user, I want persistent bottom navigation for thumb-friendly access.
Expected Behavior: Fixed bottom bar with icons for Home, Pre-Trip, Assets, Orders. Active tab shows purple + underline. Badge counts for pending items. Sync indicator dot on Home if records pending.

User Story: As a user, I want to see if I'm online or offline.
Expected Behavior: Header shows 'Offline' badge with Wi-Fi icon when navigator.onLine is false. Hidden when online.

User Story: As a worker, I want to browse all equipment to look up training, PM schedules, and compliance.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /equipment. Grid of equipment cards grouped by category with counts. Search box for real-time filtering. Category filter pills. Collapse/expand category groups.

User Story: As a worker, I want to see full equipment details: PM schedule, manuals, training, compliance.
Expected Behavior: Click equipment card → detail page with metadata, tabbed sections (overview, manuals, training, compliance), QR code label, status badge. Admin-only status toggle.

User Story: As a facility manager, I want printable QR code labels for equipment.
Expected Behavior: On equipment detail, QR section shows label with QR code, name, item number, category. Print button formats for label printing. QR links to equipment detail page.
Error Notes: 1) QR code fgColor is white (#FFFFFF) on transparent bg — invisible in light theme

User Story: As a vehicle operator, I want to run a pre-trip checklist before operating a vehicle.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /inspections. Select equipment (pre-selects last used). Categorized checklist items with Pass/Fail/N/A buttons. Fail items require notes. Critical items show badge. Photos attachable. Inspector name auto-fills.

User Story: As a maintenance coordinator, I want to track PM work orders in a kanban board.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /work-orders. Three columns: Not Started, In Progress, Complete. Cards sorted by due date, overdue first. Filter by equipment/PM type. Toggle 'Show Overdue Only'. Export CSV button.
Error Notes: 1) Status cycles backward from Complete to Not Started with single tap (line 61); 2) Delete confirm 3s timeout with no visual indicator — poor mobile UX

User Story: As a worker, I want an AI safety assistant available anytime via floating button.
Expected Behavior: Click floating 'S' icon → chat dialog opens. Quick-action chips for common queries. Type question → Sage responds. Offline FAQ fallback. History persists 15min. Draggable position. Pulse hint on first 3 launches.

User Story: As a mobile user, I want to refresh data by pulling down.
Expected Behavior: Drag down from top of page → pull handle animates → release past threshold (64px) → triggers refresh callback. Available on dashboard, work orders, and list pages.

User Story: As a user, I want to know when a new app version is available.
Expected Behavior: When service worker detects update, banner appears: 'A new version is available' + 'Update now' button → reloads with latest code.
Error Notes: 1) 'Update now' button has no min touch target height — tiny tap target on mobile

User Story: As a user, I want real-time feedback when records sync or fail.
Expected Behavior: Transient toast at bottom center. Success (green checkmark) auto-dismisses 4s. Failure (red alert) persists until dismissed. Shows message text.

User Story: As a user, I want to know if local storage is corrupted.
Expected Behavior: If storage load fails, banner appears: 'Safety records could not be loaded — storage may be corrupted. Your data backup is being restored.' Dismissable.
Error Notes: 1) Dismiss button has no min touch target size — tiny tap target on mobile

User Story: As a new user, I want a guided introduction to the app.
Expected Behavior: On first sign-in, modal: 'Welcome to Sage' + 'Take a quick tour'. Coach-mark tour through 4 steps (Home, Pre-Trip, Assets, Sage). Skip/Back/Next/Done buttons. Esc to close.
Error Notes: 1) No keyboard navigation (unlike ModuleTourEngine which has arrow keys + Escape); 2) Focus trap missing — keyboard user can tab behind overlay

User Story: As a user, I want to context-specific tours per page.
Expected Behavior: Pages with tours show 'Tour' button. Click → coach-mark tour for that page's features. Each module has own tour ID. State tracked per module.

User Story: As a first-time visitor to a page, I want a gentle hint that a tour is available.
Expected Behavior: 1.2s after landing on page with tour, pill prompt: 'First time here? Take a quick tour'. Tour/No thanks buttons. Only if: authenticated, onboarding seen, tour not taken, not globally dismissed.

User Story: As a returning user, I want to re-watch the app tour.
Expected Behavior: Click '?' button in header → triggers welcome splash → can take tour again.

User Story: As a user, I want to understand what data is collected and my rights.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /privacy. Full policy: data collection, storage (localStorage/IndexedDB/Notion), signatures, third-party services, cookies, AI features, retention, data rights.

User Story: As a user, I want to review the legal terms.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /terms. Full terms: what Sage is, AI disclaimers, user responsibilities, data ownership, service availability, liability, governing law (Texas).

User Story: As a prospective user, I want to sign up for beta access.
Expected Behavior: Navigate to /beta. Form: name, email, company, role (dropdown), crew size, reason. Carousel mockups auto-rotate. Submit sends data. Success/error message.

User Story: As a user, I want to confirm critical actions before they execute.
Expected Behavior: Destructive actions show modal: title, message, confirm button (red for danger), cancel. Some require typed confirmation.

User Story: As a user, I want visual placeholders while data loads.
Expected Behavior: Pages show skeleton loaders (gray pulsing boxes) matching content layout. Fade out as real content appears.

User Story: As a mobile user, I want to install the app on my home screen.
Expected Behavior: iOS: Share → Add to Home Screen. Android: browser install prompt. Launches in standalone mode. Splash screens for various device sizes. Manifest with icons and theme.
Error Notes: 1) Manifest theme_color hardcoded to dark (#0A0A0A) — light theme users see dark splash; 2) Missing 'id' field in manifest for stable PWA identity
